info.name: NC 3D Print
info.summary: Slice, send, and monitor Klipper/Moonraker 3D prints from Nextcloud
info.description:
NC 3D Print connects Nextcloud to Klipper printers via Moonraker: prepare models from Files, slice with an optional owned slicer sidecar, upload G-code, and monitor jobs (pause/resume/cancel, temperatures, camera).
Unlike SkyPrint or SavaPage (which target traditional CUPS / office printing), this app is purpose-built for consumer and workshop FDM printers running Klipper + Moonraker. In-browser slicing uses the separate nc-print-slicer container (OrcaSlicer-lineage engine); without it, Prepare and Moonraker monitoring still work.
Privacy: the app does not phone home or collect telemetry. It only contacts the Moonraker and slicer URLs configured by your administrator (plus your Nextcloud file storage).
See INSTALL.md for the sidecar and ADMIN.md for settings.
